what: d1-3B: every graph form measured on the way to the release, per device: its gate against the provider's fp32 oracle and its times with the window they were measured in. A form is the decoder's weights (fp16, int8 variants, int4), its static call width S, its graph form (dynamic positions with --expect-frequent-reshapes, or the static form) and where it was specialized (AOT on the Mac, the phone's JIT, the phone's AOT).
